basis.governing_question: Why do property and health claims at Atlântico Seguros take too long to settle, and what claims operating model should it move to?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why property and health claims take too long to settle and where the delay arises.

gate.label: Findings sign-off
gate.decision: Are the diagnostic findings accepted as the basis for the design phase?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target claims operating model and the recommendations the Board will receive.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Release the report and board presentation for the Board meeting?

workstreams.name: Claims process baseline
workstreams.answers: How long do property and health claims take at each step today, and how satisfied are customers?
activities: Map each step of property and health claim handling
Analyze operational data on settlement times by step
Review customer satisfaction results by claim type

deliverables.name: Process map of property and health claims

workstreams.name: Handler and customer views
workstreams.answers: What do handlers and customers say slows property and health claims down?
activities: Interview claims handlers and managers who do the work
Interview customers with recent property or health claims
Review documents on the 2024 lean program for motor claims

deliverables.name: Interview synthesis of claims handling pain points

workstreams.name: Root causes and priorities
workstreams.answers: Why do property and health claims settle slowly, and which improvement areas matter most?
activities: Compare property and health handling with motor claims
Test delay hypotheses against claims data and interviews
Rank improvement areas by effect on settlement time

deliverables.name: Root causes of settlement delay by claim type

workstreams.name: Target model options
workstreams.answers: Which claims operating models could Atlântico Seguros move to for property and health claims?
activities: Define design criteria from the diagnostic findings
Develop alternative claims operating models for review
Check each option against the existing claims IT system

deliverables.name: Claims operating model options compared on agreed criteria

workstreams.name: Option impact assessment
workstreams.answers: How would each option change settlement time and customer satisfaction for property and health claims?
activities: Estimate each option's effect on settlement time
Assess each option's risk to customer satisfaction
Test assumptions with claims handlers and operational data

deliverables.name: Option impact on settlement time and satisfaction

workstreams.name: Recommendation and roadmap
workstreams.answers: What is the detailed design of the chosen model, and how does Atlântico Seguros get there?
activities: Detail the chosen model's process, roles and governance
Sequence the steps to move to the chosen model
Draft the written report and board presentation

deliverables.name: Detailed design of the chosen model and roadmap
Written report and board presentation with recommendations

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, access and success measures
events.decision: Are the scope and success criteria agreed as the basis for the work?
agenda: Present the approach, phases and steering calendar
Align on the scope for property and health claims
Confirm access to claims data and to handlers for interviews

events.label: Workshop 1: first findings
events.decision: Which delay areas should the root-cause analysis focus on?
agenda: Present the process map and settlement time baseline
Review pain points raised by handlers and customers
Decide which delay areas to examine in depth

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.decision: Are the diagnostic findings accepted as the basis for the design phase?
agenda: Present root causes of delay in property and health claims
Decide whether the findings are accepted for design

events.label: Workshop 2: model options
events.purpose: Review options and impact; choose direction
events.decision: Which claims operating model option goes forward to detailed design?
agenda: Present the operating model options and how each was assessed
Review the expected effect on settlement time and satisfaction
Decide which option to detail for the recommendation

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Sign off materials ahead of the Board
events.decision: Release the report and board presentation for the Board meeting?
agenda: Present the written report and board presentation
Review the detailed design of the chosen model and roadmap
Confirm what goes to the Board for decision

architect_notes: The brief gives no engagement length; Diagnostic (6 to 8 weeks) and Design (8 to 10 weeks) are estimates within the 19 weeks available.
Not covered by the phases: ASF, new supervisor guidance on claims-handling response times. Confirm whether it is in scope.
Following the operating model redesign method, I merged detailed design and transition planning into one stream with a roadmap, as the brief excludes implementation support.
